content: {"summary":"The June 2026 evening checkout slowdown is traced to DNS resolution delays. Lost DNS replies cause the resolver to wait the 5 s timeout and retry, producing 5 s outliers and, when both attempts fail, EAI_AGAIN errors and 10 s latency. Because Node’s dns.lookup runs in libuv’s 4‑thread worker pool, concurrent lookups during traffic bursts queue on those threads, amplifying the delay for all requests in the burst.","likely_cause":"DNS lookup timeouts due to lost UDP replies combined with libuv thread‑pool contention","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"DNS lookups sometimes wait the full 5 s timeout when a reply is missing, causing the observed 5 s latency spikes.","evidence_ids":["RB-021#4"],"quote":"When a reply is missing, the resolver waits out its 5 s timeout and asks that query again."},{"text":"Two lookups exceeded 5 s, confirming the delay originates from DNS lookups, not database queries.","evidence_ids":["RB-021#3"],"quote":"Two took just over 5,000 ms. So: lookups, not queries."},{"text":"Lost DNS replies trigger retries; when both attempts fail the resolver returns EAI_AGAIN, explaining the rare error lines.","evidence_ids":["RB-021#5","RB-021#4"],"quote":"Two lost replies on two different queries of the same lookup, each recovered by its retry, cost about 10 s."},{"text":"Node’s dns.lookup uses libuv’s worker pool, which has only four threads, so concurrent lookups during bursts queue and delay all requests.","evidence_ids":["RB-021#1","RB-021#5"],"quote":"Node's dns.lookup hands getaddrinfo to libuv's worker pool, which has 4 threads."},{"text":"The pattern of slow requests (stacking near 5 s or 10 s, with time spent inside orders‑api) matches DNS timeout behavior.","evidence_ids":["RB-021#7"],"quote":"Slow requests stack near 5 s or 10 s; the edge says the time is inside the service."}],"next_checks":["Monitor DNS server packet loss and retry metrics during evening traffic bursts","Increase UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE or move DNS lookups to a cached resolver to reduce thread contention","Check resolv.conf search suffixes to minimize the number of queries per lookup","Run a controlled test injecting artificial DNS latency to confirm the latency profile","Review libuv thread‑pool usage in orders‑api and consider off‑loading DNS resolution"]}
